generation.enumeration: every source x every primitive record x every selected source port x every selected primitive port

selection.B: descending bounded parent count, then witness count, then SHA-256
selection.D: greedy farthest-point over the frozen pre-outcome record vector; initial/tie break by SHA-256
selection.L: first SHA-ordered child per SHA-ordered L15 source where available, then SHA-order fill
selection.O: descending repeated-port pair score, then bounded parent count, witness count, SHA-256
selection.S: ascending distinct exposed port-type count, then maximum port-type multiplicity, then SHA-256
selection.selected_union: deduplicated union of all five sealed lanes, sorted by SHA-256

source_scope: Exactly the 1,089 records in the pinned L15 selected relation; no additions or replacement roots.
stopping_rules: Stop after complete one-step generation over all 1,089 roots.
Stop after deterministic five-lane sealing and bounded relation analysis.
Stop after cheap Spectroscope, comparison/classification, and golden verification.
No adaptive lane extension, panel growth, census, or deep ancestry search.
Fail closed on any hash, premise, output, checkpoint, or golden science-projection mismatch.
